title: epan: Use unsigned for offset variables in packet-[0-9a-b]* dissectors
description:
Change local offset variables and static helper function parameters
from int to unsigned across dissectors starting with 0-9, A, and B.

Ping #20103

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)
